newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Confessions of two British nurses charged with murdering their Australian colleague have been officially filed and sent to three judges, police chief says.
- Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) identifies investment opportunities in various chemicals used in the manufacture of insecticides and pharmaceutical products.
- Electricity and industry ministry studies building four industrial cities in the kingdom.
- Saudi agriculture and water ministry licences 66 agricultural projects worth 121.6 million riyals.
